keyword: why is tsa not getting paid
claims: TSA agents are not getting paid.
A partial government shutdown has caused a lapse in funding for the Department of Homeland Security (DHS).
About 95% of the 60,000 employees are considered essential.
Essential employees are required to work without pay.
The funding lapse started in February 2026.
The funding lapse means there is no authorized budget for paychecks.
TSA agents are known as excepted employees.
Excepted employees must work without pay for their regular hours.
Excepted employees must work without pay for any overtime.
A 2019 law ensures backpay once funding resumes.
High callout rates are over 40% at some airports.
The White House rejected an offer for a private party to pay the workers' salaries.
The current shutdown follows a previous record-long shutdown.
